verdict.rationale: Omarchy's own docs say it offers AI dictation via Voxtype. You dictate by holding F9 or toggling with Super + Ctrl + X, and the text appears in whatever input area has focus, so it works system-wide. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that dictation works across apps, and detail on the AI model or setup (the docs say "once installed", so it may need an extra install step rather than being on by default).
